purpose: Render a structured concept, summary, or framework as a mind map.

rawDataContract.notes: Accept authored Markdown, a local UTF-8 Markdown file, or a local JSON file with explicit row-field/grouping or tree mapping. No model transcription is needed for a full structured dataset.

dataSource.path: local JSON path, relative to invocation cwd or absolute

modelInstructions: For an authored summary, generate a specific root and evidence-backed branches. For large structured data or a request for all records, use dataSource mappings or --content-file instead of transcribing every record or silently reducing the dataset.
The h1 root title must be specific to the user's topic and evidence; do not use generic titles such as 思维导图, 今日市场热点, Mind Map, Summary, or Market Hotspots.
Do not create branches or leaves for 数据来源, 来源, 日期, 参考, source, date, references, or methodology; citations/provenance are shown elsewhere.
Omit low-value missing-data nodes such as 原文未披露, 未完整披露, 无法核实, unavailable, unknown, or not disclosed.
Use first-level branches for decision-useful clusters such as conclusion, drivers, evidence, affected sectors/entities, risks/divergences, and next checkpoints.
Do not overload branches with long prose; split concrete facts into short parent and child nodes.
The canvas has a top-right fullscreen button on desktop/mobile; native fullscreen retains drag/zoom/fit and exit. Prefer concise labels, but do not drop records in file-mapping mode.

fileInputs.content-file: --content-file outputs/data/map.md reads authored Markdown directly; mutually exclusive with dataSource/inline content
fileInputs.payload: --payload reads local JSON configuration; data.content supports existing Markdown; dataSource reads raw structured JSON
fileInputs.rowMode: recordsPath selects an array; groupBy is an optional array of field paths or {field,labels} objects. labelFields is required, with field path/string or {field,label,suffix}. Missing field paths fail rather than silently discard records. Null values display —. Every row is included, with no automatic summarization/truncation. title supplies the root.
fileInputs.treeMode: dataSource.path plus treePath (array of keys, [] for root) reads a {name,children[]} tree directly. No labelFields needed.
fileInputs.provenance: receipt.fileSource and saved payload._fileSource include path, SHA-256, mapping and recordCount. HTML embeds resolved content and does not fetch the source file at viewing time.
